## Highlights

- **Full commit-pinned Apache-2.0 LOLDrivers and LOLRMM IOC feeds.** Reproducible sync scripts (`tools/sync_loldrivers.py` and `tools/sync_lolrmm.py`) expand `windows-advanced` from 30 to **1,884 verified LOLDrivers vulnerable-driver SHA-256 hashes** and add **292 filtered LOLRMM relay and service domains** to `windows-hunting` and `linux-hunting`, all automatically screened against CC0 MISP warninglists, Rustinel `[ioc]` matcher syntax, and an explicit consumer/marketing denylist.
- **29 new Sigma detections across Windows, Linux, and macOS (207 production artifacts total: 195 Sigma, 9 YARA, 3 IOC).**
  - **Windows execution, lateral movement, persistence, tunneling, and Security/PowerShell:** downloaded script hosts, signed `.NET` build tools in writable paths, WMI/WinRM shells, PsExec/renamed PsExec, ClickFix Explorer lures, COM hijacking, LSA/Auth package registration, Netsh helper/AppInit DLL, user-writable service `ImagePath`, accessibility binary replacement, Office startup-folder drops, `.NET` runtime loads in script hosts, `certutil -decode`, web-root web shells, PowerShell reverse shells, tunneling tools (`ngrok`, `cloudflared`, `chisel`, `frpc`, `plink -R`), `ps_script`/`ps_module` credential-tool markers, RBCD (`5136`), Cobalt Strike named-pipe `getsystem`, service-account-to-`SYSTEM` escalation, and PSReadLine history deletion.
  - **Cross-platform RMM staging & Unix hardening/collection:** RMM staging-path detections across Windows, Linux, and macOS; Linux `setcap` privilege grants, `~/.ssh/rc` / `/etc/ssh/sshrc` persistence, and unexpected `/etc/passwd` / `/etc/shadow` writers; macOS non-platform `screencapture` and scripted clipboard access.
- **ATT&CK v18.1 validation & IOC false-positive guard.** Validates all ATT&CK claims against the complete 691-entry Enterprise ATT&CK v18.1 catalog (flagging deprecated/revoked IDs), enforces UUID v4/provenance/`modified`-date checks and `rustinel.roles`, separates YARA technique context from behavioral coverage, and screens every production IOC against vendored CC0 MISP warninglists.
- **Scalable CI and test layout.** Replaces hardcoded replay steps with parallel auto-discovery (`tests/replay/run_all.py`), caches the pinned Rustinel engine binary across 3 Windows atomic shards, and splits atomic test manifests under `tests/atomic/manifests/`.

## Upgrade notes

- **Engine compatibility unchanged (`>=1.11.0`).** All Advanced and Hunting packs remain certified on Rustinel `v1.11.0` and also work cleanly on `v1.12.0`. Essential pack floors and Essential pack membership are unchanged.
- Pack counts in `v0.7.0`: `windows-essential` (19 rules), `windows-advanced` (102 rules, 1,906 IOCs), `windows-hunting` (115 rules, 2,198 IOCs), `linux-essential` (10 rules), `linux-advanced` (47 rules, 22 IOCs), `linux-hunting` (48 rules, 314 IOCs), `macos-essential` (5 rules), `macos-advanced` (41 rules, 22 IOCs).
- Upgrade installed packs with `rustinel rules update`.
